BackgroundNormal.why: Lists and views are tone 2, as in the prototype. A well (tone 0) is drawn by the Union style from its own variable, not from this set (D-90)

BackgroundAlternate.why: The prototype's views have no stripes, so the alternate row is the normal tone (D-90)

ForegroundActive.why: Accent is the one strong colour; as text it reaches 4.5:1 through the pairs of neutral

ForegroundNegative.why: D-87; danger is a fill, too dark for text

DecorationFocus.why: Keyboard focus stays visible where an application draws its own frame (D-88)

DecorationHover.why: The set's BackgroundNormal, so that a hover frame drawn by an application does not show (D-4, D-88)

BackgroundNormal.why: Sidebars, panels and status bars around a view: the view itself is the View set, tone 2 (D-95)
The dark gold of selected text; folder icons take it too (D-110)

BackgroundAlternate.why: A selected alternate row is the same fill (D-110)

ForegroundNormal.why: A selected item's text keeps its colour, as in Breeze, 5.95:1 (D-110)

ForegroundInactive.why: Dim text reaches only 3.00:1 on the text selection, so secondary text is text (D-110)

ForegroundActive.why: Accent reaches only 3.68:1 as text on the text selection (D-110)

ForegroundLink.why: Links and status colours reach 3.3:1 to 3.4:1 on the text selection, so they lose their hue there, as on Breeze's selection (D-110)

DecorationFocus.why: Accent marks focus on the text selection at 3.68:1 (D-88, D-110)

DecorationHover.why: The set's BackgroundNormal, so that a hover frame does not show (D-88)

BackgroundAlternate.why: A tooltip has no second tone

BackgroundNormal.why: The darkest surface, for overlays; Plasma's shell is out of scope (D-18)
The title bar and the toolbar are tone 0
The same as Header: an inactive window is shown by the decoration (shadow, dim title), not by a toolbar tone (D-90)

Color.why: Unused while ColorEffect is 0; a warm value, so that the file holds no grey

ContrastAmount.rule: The amount a, rounded to two places, at which text faded towards tone-2 has the relative luminance of text-dim. The generator computes it (P2.2); the fade formula is unverified and is checked by eye in P2.3
ContrastAmount.why: Disabled text is dim text in the prototype (D-91)

ChangeSelectionColor.why: A selection keeps its accent in an inactive window

Color.why: Unused while the effect is off; a warm value, so that the file holds no grey

Enable.why: An inactive window is shown by the decoration alone (D-91)

ColorScheme.why: Every part is shown as Amber

Name.why: Every part is shown as Amber

shadeSortColumn.why: The prototype tints no sorted column (D-91)

contrast.why: Flattens the bevel roles Qt derives (Light, Mid, Dark, Shadow); unverified, checked in P2.3 (D-91)

frameContrast.why: The derived frame colour then equals the background, so no hairline frame shows; group and effect unverified, checked in P2.3 (D-91)

activeBackground.why: The title bar; read by other decorations and some applications, not by Amber's
